decisive_items: perseveration on the Clock Drawing Test
response.rationale: R5 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive set of supporting spans, including disorganized speech, severe anxiety, self-harm behaviors, and prominent frontal and temporal features, which are all consistent with frontotemporal dementia. R1 is the runner-up because it also has some supporting spans, such as abrupt onset of disorganized speech and severe anxiety, but lacks the breadth of supporting evidence seen in R5.

rejected.why: while R3 has some supporting spans, such as perseveration on the Clock Drawing Test, it lacks the overall breadth of evidence seen in R5 and R1
R2 has some supporting spans, such as disorganized speech and Wernicke’s aphasia, but they are not as comprehensive as those seen in R5 and R1
